purpose: Teach: 小切手/インターンシップ/本案/公言/借り入れ/呼び名/生年月日/ベーシック

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費の小切手扱いに注意しろ
lines.en: Ren, be careful with how you handle the research-fund paperwork.
lines.style: Direct but not unkind. Brief pause before his name — he has Hiroshi's full attention. Measured delivery, the tone of someone who's seen mistakes before. Slight emphasis on 「注意しろ」, not harsh, just clear.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。インターンシップで学べる事を生かしたいです
lines.en: Yes. I want to make the most of what I'm learning through this internship.
lines.style: Quick, respectful agreement. Slight upward inflection at the beginning — eagerness controlled by formality. Steady pace, no rushing. He means it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、本案を指導教授に確認してもらえ
lines.en: Ren, get your advisor to review this proposal before you move forward.
lines.style: Same measured tone as the first line. Practical instruction, not a suggestion. Slight weight on 「確認してもらえ」 — this is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究目的を学会で公言いたします
lines.en: Yes. I'll announce the research purpose at an academic conference.
lines.style: Polite formality maintained throughout. No stumbling — he's prepared this response. Calm, methodical delivery. Small pause before 「学会で」, showing he's thought this through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費の借り入れ制度を活用しろ
lines.en: Ren, make use of the research-loan system available to you.
lines.style: Practical advice delivered with confidence. Slight upward lilt on 「活用しろ」 — not a command but a genuine suggestion from experience. Warm underneath the directness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究プロジェクトの呼び名を共同研究者と決めました
lines.en: Yes. I've already decided on the project name with my collaborators.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction in his voice — he came prepared. Brief, professional. Shows initiative without needing praise. Steady cadence throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、被験者の生年月日確認を徹底しろ
lines.en: Ren, make absolutely certain you verify each participant's date of birth.
lines.style: Shifts to something more serious. Slower pace. Weight on 「徹底しろ」 — this is about protocol, about protecting the research. The tone of someone who's seen what carelessness costs.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文でベーシックな統計手法を扱います
lines.en: Yes. I'll be using standard statistical methods in the paper.
lines.style: Closing statement, slightly diminished in energy but not defeated. He's summarized clearly, shown he understands. Trails very slightly at the end — appropriate place to stop speaking. Respectful finish.
